heard: Hundreds watched the burning ship, unaware it was a munitions vessel. On December 6, 1917, the ship blew apart. Sparks from a collision had ignited deck benzol. It became the largest human-made explosion before the atomic age. The Richmond District was completely obliterated. Flying glass blinded hundreds watching from their windows. Two thousand people died in the catastrophe. Hundreds watched the the burning ship before the harbor vanished.
